title: Suta Son Jalebi Orange Checkered Cotton Zari Saree
shortDescription: Son Jalebi never believed in taking the straight route. Why would she, when twists and turns were so much more fun?
description:
Son Jalebi never believed in taking the straight route. Why would she, when twists and turns were so much more fun? Dressed in sunny orange checks, she was already the life of the mithai box, but her heart belonged to pink. So, naturally, she saved her brightest pink pallu for the grandest entrances.

She loved a little chaos, a lot of laughter and celebrations that went on long after the sweets were gone. While everyone else tried to keep things neat and predictable, Son Jalebi twirled her way through every occasion, leaving a trail of colour and happy glances behind. Because life, according to her, was much sweeter when you added a twist.
